title: Message/set update nonexistent ID returns serverFail instead of notFound
description: In message.rs process_update, when update_read_at is called with a nonexistent message ID, kith-store returns KithError::Store("message not found: {id}"). process_update maps ALL errors from update_read_at via .map_err(|e| json!({"type": "serverFail", "description": e.to_string()})), so the notUpdated SetError has type=serverFail. RFC 8620 §5.3 requires type=notFound when the object ID does not exist in the account. Compare: contact.rs process_update correctly checks get_by_peer_user_id before calling the store mutator and returns notFound explicitly. Message/set should do the same: call messages().get(server_id) first and return notFound if absent.
